output.population: Nine post-ischemic VT patients, contributing 1962 entries collected using the CARTO 3 mapping system.
output.summary: Open-access recordings from post-ischemic ventricular tachycardia patients: intracardiac electrograms, 12-lead surface ECGs and electroanatomical maps, annotated by three electrophysiologists with a consensus, plus spatial information on ablations performed.
